definitions.explanation: The second sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly April 20 to May 20. Also the constellation Taurus. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{妹|いもうと}→妹：00573_imouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{牡牛座|おうしざ}だ。
examples.english: My little sister is a Taurus.

examples.japanese: {牡牛座|おうしざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦のんびり→のんびり：01596_nonbiri⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Taurus people are said to be easygoing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{占|うらな}い→占い：18736_uranai⟧で、⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{牡牛座|おうしざ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{恋愛|れんあい}→恋愛：12634_renai⟧⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてあった→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The magazine horoscope said Taurus has good luck in love this month.

notes:
The zodiac sign Taurus, for people born from late April to late May. The {牡|お} prefix marks the male animal (bull).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牡牛座|おうしざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person born under Taurus
- {牡牛座|おうしざ}⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧: born a Taurus
- {牡牛座|おうしざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運勢|うんせい}→運勢：15761_unsei⟧: the Taurus horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are common small-talk in Japan and appear in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments (⟦{星占|ほしうらな}い→星占い：18861_hoshiuranai⟧).
